title: Dream self
content: Tonight (04/26/2025) was the first time that I was able to remember my dreams after 5 consecutive nights of being unable to remember of what I dream. Thing is somehow, I usually feel hazy whenever I am becoming more lucid in the astral realm. This time, it felt like my mind was constantly shifting between my conscious and subconscious self in the astral realm, to the point in which my subconscious mind just decided to take my astral body inside a dark room and from there proceeded to sleep which forced me to fully wake up from my dream. I don't know why but it seems that my dream self doesn't want me to become fully lucid so it forces itself to go to sleep. I never went to sleep before inside my own dreams. It's as if I become fully lucid for a minute then I go back to state of haziness and semi sleepwalking within my own dreams. Btw, this is my first time that this ever happened to me.
